instructions: Bind parameters from the same guarded disposable fixture. Capture EXPLAIN FORMAT=JSON of each exact SELECT, SHOW CREATE TABLE/SHOW INDEX, RR transaction identity, data_locks/data_lock_waits with real competing sessions, and post-release outcomes. No FORCE INDEX, narrowed predicates, EXPLAIN ANALYZE, production writes or DDL are authorized by this file.
transaction_observations: Use a guarded disposable fixture and both the actual restricted identity and privileged metadata observer.
Keep the existing L0/L1/L2 prefix. Lock receipts at L3, run and historical binding at L4, then references at L5. Record exact index/lock modes and held empty ranges.
Receipts are reread with the same L3 predicate after the original L4 owner lock; Recheck must use original locked keys and must not acquire new prefix keys.
Validate original manifest, evidence creation, owner-write/observation/retention deadlines, exact object version, complete typed C1 rows and rollback after late changes.

Retained producer C1 rows are read only. Complete current worker authority, metadata/DDL freeze, other dependencies, physical reservation and tombstone lifecycle still need their own approval and actual evidence.

queries.sql: SELECT TABLE_NAME,TABLE_TYPE,COALESCE(ENGINE,'') FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME IN ('system_backup_producer_evidence_bindings','system_backup_producer_evidence_refs','system_backup_producer_result_receipts','system_backup_producer_runs') ORDER BY BINARY TABLE_NAME
queries.observation: Compare exact four BASE TABLE/InnoDB identities with the privileged observer. Complete columns/FKs/indexes/CHECKs/triggers/programs and current grants are separate prerequisites.

queries.sql: SELECT scope_key,scope_bytes,run_id,evidence_id,grant_id,grant_generation,owner_write_expires_at,observation_expires_at,retention_expires_at,IF(OCTET_LENGTH(record_bytes) BETWEEN 1 AND 32768,record_bytes,NULL),record_sha256 FROM system_backup_producer_evidence_bindings WHERE evidence_id=? ORDER BY scope_key,evidence_id LIMIT 10001
queries.observation: Initial RR hint selects no mutation authority; compare every original binding with the independently locked L4 record.

queries.sql: SELECT scope_key,scope_bytes,receipt_key_hash,request_hash,run_id,evidence_id,target_hash,result_version,committed_at,retention_expires_at,charged_bytes,IF(OCTET_LENGTH(record_bytes) BETWEEN 1 AND 98304,record_bytes,NULL),record_sha256 FROM system_backup_producer_result_receipts WHERE evidence_id=? ORDER BY scope_key,receipt_key_hash LIMIT 10001 FOR UPDATE
queries.observation: Predicate intentionally covers all scopes for this evidence. Capture actual index choice, rows examined, unrelated-scope impact, and exact requesting/blocking connection IDs. LIMIT 10001 is a result/overflow guard, not a plan-cost or lock-span bound.
